text_markup: When the Corp installs a card with the subtype {subtype:region} into the root of a server that already has a {subtype:region}, they must trash the already-installed {subtype:region}. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
text_plain: When the Corp installs a card with the subtype region into the root of a server that already has a region, they must trash the already-installed region. See section 8.5.
